name: s81sl_xr3
structural_change: ROOT4-S81POST 10-19: FIRST xr3 kit (no earlier xr3 route). C3 variant of the closed xr1 (s81sl_xr1f-12b616b54; same XR2..XR7 structure, FOREG 1) plus the band port B: bi input flops, the bo 513-b {pk, valid} register, and the S81-SMWIRE SO assembler (main 0408184bd). SAFE checklist: 1 pins PASS (source-registered: every input a flop at the pin, every output a flop; reset_landing 2 stages); 2 reach PASS (pin flops anchored at the faces by io_flop_at_pins, 16 regional clock roots km16; longest flop->flop span is inside a 570 x 395 tile with registered classify stage); 3 fanout FIXED: the SO lo/hi capture enables (b_so && so_n == 0 / 1, 512 loads each) are now KEPT registered copies one per 8 bits (sol_c / soh_c 64 + 64) over a staged word so_w (verified: flow keep hook ot_keep_regs.tcl keeps 64/64 + 64/64 on the paramod, sos_r 69, cis_c 69); the SO ci select sos_c is a kept copy per 16 bits; every XR5 kept copy as xr1; 4 depth PASS (as xr1; SO beat select is a registered one-hot); 5 storage PASS (no runtime-indexed flop arrays; so_lo / so_hi / so_w are 512-b registers, not delay lines); 6 floorplan waived-with-reason (pin-bound, util ~7%, see outline_why; no macros; aspect 1.44); 7 clock PASS (km16 regional roots, pin-flop spread checked by the --cts gate, io_hold_margin 0.03); 8 schedule PASS (static; the enable fix adds 0 cycles: lo / hi are captured one edge after their B word and both are valid in the so_go cycle as before).

job.purpose: S81 C3 control-plane sub-leaf ot_s81sl_xr3 (HB 1: band port B, S81-SMWIRE SO assembler) -- first hardened view; SAFE item 3 fix on the SO lo/hi capture enables (KEPT copies 64+64).

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81-SLICE): every input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop (ot_s81sl_xr header); recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every slice seam.

pin_reg_split_why: XR6 fallback (FOREG=1): fault leaves a dedicated output flop (fault <= fcore), no recirculation at the pin flop, so io_flop_at_pins anchors it; no pin_reg_split.
outline_why: ROOT4-S81POST 10-19: first xr3 (C3, HB 1) kit, from the closed s81sl_xr1f kit: same faces + the band port B (bi 1104 in, bo 513 out) on S (the slice band face: pvrd lands bi from below, bo feeds the svc entry q below). Pin-bound: 9,268 pins; S 3,276 on 570.24 um = 5.9/um sets the width, E 2,214 on 395.28 = 5.7/um the height (as xr1f); ranges spread uniformly per face, scalars 2.16 um, clk at the E-face centre. Util ~7% (std ~16k um2 est.): the 40-60% target is unreachable without cutting boundary bits (slice seam architecture), as xr1f.
